propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit, when it actually accepts any commit reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status
The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and completion-verification gate status, not unconditional as documented
AGENTS.md omits documentation of rebar transition --ref, the sanctioned way to close a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree
The referencing-commit check accepts the ticket or any transitive descendant (subtree), not just the single ticket ID
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy, not by the precheck mechanism
--ref retargets completion verification and signature to a specified tree but does not narrow the referencing-commit scan
